newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 11.0/13.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 11.0/13.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 11.0/13.0 percent on Wednesday, dealers said.
They said the overnight money tended to ease but overall trading activity was slow. One Japanese bank dealer said supply was not that ample despite some easing in the rate.
He said the supply was coming mainly from state banks and an early injection from the central bank of 325 billion rupiah.
Dealers said operators were generally holding back from offering because of the month-end factor.
They said longer-term rates were stable, with some buying interest from some state banks seen in three-month money.
The average overnight interbank rate on Tuesday was 10.80 percent, compared with 11.22 percent on Monday.
